While not a dedicated PTM-enrichment run (like TiO2), the search parameters specifically targeted phosphosites and ubiquitin remnants (GlyGly), and the study's goal was to analyze the EGFR interactome and its PTMs.

scope: The supernatant was then subjected for immponoprecipitation. 3 mg of cell lysate was incubated overnight at 4 °C with 60 μl of a 50% slurry of cross-linked beads.

the IP eluates were loaded into a pre-cast SDS-PAGE gel (4–15% Mini-PROTEAN TGX Precast Protein Gel, 10-well, 50 μL) and proteins were only run for approximately 2 cm to minimise protein separation. Protein bands were excised and diced, and proteins were reduced... Proteins were then digested with 100–150 ng trypsin

The lysates were immunoprecipitated with α-EGFR antibody (or normal mouse IgG). The proteins were eluted using Sample Loading Buffer and run into a 1D precast SDS-PAGE gel before undergoing tryptic digestion for LC-MS/MS analysis.
